description:
THIS IS NOT A SOLICITATION.  THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION ONLY.  SEE ATTACHMENTS FOR FULL DETAILS. 

 The anticipated project includes, but is not limited to: 

 • Furnishing and installing a large roll-up door within an existing non-load-bearing concrete masonry unit (CMU) wall. 

 • Demolition, cutting, removal, framing, finishing, and related work necessary to create the new door opening. 

 • Relocation and/or modification of affected utilities, including electrical power, compressed air, and water lines. 

 • Relocation of an existing air-conditioning unit and associated ductwork to accommodate installation and operation of new equipment. 

 • Restoration of affected interior and exterior finishes. 

 • Coordination of work in an operational facility and compliance with installation access, safety, environmental, and utility-outage requirements. 

 See the attached questionnaire for full details available at this time.
